sessions.title: Oracle AI DB Everywhere: From Multicloud Complexity to an AI-Ready Data Estate
sessions.description: As enterprises adopt AI, the question isn't "which cloud should my Oracle Database run on?" but "how do I make my data secure and AI-ready wherever my applications run?" With Oracle AI Database now available across OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments, you can bring mission-critical data closer to applications, analytics, and AI. But technology alone is not a strategy. We share a practical blueprint for turning a fragmented Oracle estate into an AI-ready, unified multicloud platform: assessing dependencies, placing each workload, migrating with lower risk, designing for sovereignty, and unifying security, governance, FinOps, and AIOps. We then look beyond migration to trusted data for AI, RAG, and agentic applications.

sessions.title: Multicloud Security with Paramount and Native
sessions.description: Multicloud strategies can be easier to design than to operationalize consistently at global media scale. The session also examines Oracle’s multicloud vision and how OCI supports complex enterprise environments.
